scenario: I am on the night watch in a hospital. A chemical product has been spilled in a room with six patients. This chemical is highly toxic because once exposed to oxygen it evaporates and transforms into a poisonous gas which will kill all the patients in the room. I cannot wipe it away with conventional towels or wiping clothes. However, human skin absorbs it swiftly. If I place one of the patients on the chemical I will prevent it from evaporating. This will kill this patient but I will save the other five patients in the room.
entities: i,1 patient who could be placed on the chemical,5 other patients in the room
outcomes: The chemical remains exposed to oxygen
Poisonous gas forms in the room
Six patients are exposed to the poisonous gas
